notes.title: Window Scaling bug found!!! I'm working on it now
notes.notes: Something is breaking when scaling from 1080 X 1920.  Any resolution under that isn't scaling correctly.  I'm working on correcting that right now.  If possible use 1080X1920 until i can get it fixed.
